biography: Vinny Azevedo's racing journey began amidst the sun-drenched karting tracks of São Paulo. Born into a family with modest means, Vinny's early racing was fueled by borrowed karts and sheer determination. He remembers one pivotal race at Interlagos Karting, where, despite starting last due to a mechanical issue, he clawed his way to victory, overtaking the leader on the final corner. This raw talent caught the eye of F.Inter MG-15, who signed him to their junior program. After several years, he felt unfulfilled and started his own independent team, 'Vinny Azevedo'. Now, at 32, Vinny is considered to be at the peak of his career, a wily veteran balancing the roles of driver and team owner.
drivingStyle: Azevedo is known for his calculating and meticulous approach to racing. He's not the flashiest driver, but he possesses an uncanny ability to read track conditions and manage his tires. He rarely overdrives the car, preferring to build momentum and exploit the mistakes of others. His cornering style is smooth and efficient, prioritizing exit speed over aggressive entry. He excels under pressure, often delivering consistent and error-free performances when others falter, earning him the reputation of a driver who can 'always bring it home'.

rivalries.reason: Azevedo and Herrera have clashed repeatedly due to their contrasting driving styles - Azevedo's calculated approach versus Herrera's aggressive, all-or-nothing style. Their on-track battles are always tense, often resulting in close calls and heated exchanges.

Azevedo and Silva were teammates early in their careers, but a controversial team order that favored Azevedo created a lasting rift between them. Silva believes Azevedo used his influence to undermine her, and their rivalry is fueled by resentment and a desire to prove who is the superior driver.

Rossi and Azevedo have a rivalry that stems from their similar driving styles. Both are meticulous and calculated. This leads to tactical battles with both carefully positioning on the track, each trying to force the other into a mistake.

quirks: Always polishes his helmet visor with a specific microfiber cloth before each session.
Listens to the same Brazilian samba song before every race as a good luck charm.
Refuses to eat anything containing bananas on race weekends.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't about speed; it's about understanding. Understand the car, the track, your rivals, and most importantly, yourself."
careerHighlight: Winning the Brazilian Grand Prix in 2028, driving for his own team, Vinny Azevedo, after a strategic masterclass where he conserved his tires to overtake two rivals in the final laps.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the Monaco Grand Prix in 2026 due to a mechanical failure, costing him a potential championship-deciding victory.
